title: Branch Manager
description:
Join our financial institution as a Branch Manager. Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee daily branch operations, ensuring exceptional customer service.
- Drive sales of banking products and services to meet branch targets.
- Manage, train, and develop branch staff.
- Ensure compliance with all banking regulations and internal policies.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or related field.
- Extensive experience in retail banking, with proven leadership experience.
- Strong sales and customer service orientation.
- Excellent communication and management skills.
